title: Pia Carrot e Youkoso!! We've Been Waiting for You
native_title: Ｐｉａ♥キャロットへようこそ！！
overview:
A romance simulation set during the summer vacation of your final year of high school. After losing a bet with his father over his grades, Yusuke has to give up his summer plans and work at the family restaurant Pia Carrot, where he meets a staff of attractive women, each with her own personality.

Plan how to spend each day. Study or make phone calls in the morning, work shifts as a cashier, waiter or cook in the afternoon, and see what happens after work. Raise stats such as Style, Kindness, Guts and Academics, manage your money, and call the women or ask them out on dates.

- Uniform Select mode lets you choose the restaurant's uniforms
- Full voice for the female characters
- Original animation and an added scenario with an extra character
- Supports the Shuttle Mouse and the Sega Multi Controller
